title: Gibson Brite Wire Reinforced Electric Guitar Strings, Light Gauge

long_description.body:
Developed under the direction of Gibson’s Master Luthiers, Gibson Brite Wire Electric Guitar Strings feature a hex-shaped, high-tensile tinned steel core precision-wound with nickel-plated steel for durability and powerful tone. Compared to pure nickel strings, nickel-plated steel strings are not only louder with increased treble, but the ferromagnetic property of steel results in stronger interaction with your guitar’s pickups. Made for a wide range of styles, Gibson Brite Wire Electric Guitar Strings are factory-spec in the Gibson USA facility.



The hex-shaped, high-tensile tinned steel core provides strength and volume, while the nickel-plated steel wrap ensures superior sustain and crisp attack
Uncoated for authentic electric feel and sound
Developed and tested by Gibson Master Luthiers for all guitars from the Gibson USA facility
Made in the USA
Ultra-Light Gauge: .009, .011, .016p, .024, .032, .042
Light Gauge: .010, .013, .017p, .026, .036, .046
Medium Gauge: .011, .014, .018p, .028, .038, .050
12-String Gauge: .010/.010, .013/.013, .017p/.008, .026/.012, .036/.018, .046/.026
